title: The Second Letters
author: Gideon Amberdale
blurb: Coral Vane, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
